title: Tape running out, George Washington joke
summary: As the tape nears its end Allen has Mazzari repeat an Italian punchline about Washington crossing the Delaware.

blocks.x: Yeah, I don't know what to say because the tape's about to run off, why don't we let it run off? Just let it rip. Okay. The first thing I want to know is, see as you're calling up leave, is what did George Washington say when he crossed the Delaware?
Oh, he said, fa no cazzo di freddo. Good. That's out of the way.
